title: Seven-Repo Data Intelligence Audit
subtitle: Seven repos under ~/dev/git-folder were graded on the same rubric — collect, assess, structure, extract insight, synthesize at multiple lengths, model flexibility, and Codex / Claude Code integration — to see how they could compose into one data-intelligence workflow.

dimensions.label: Data collection
dimensions.question: sources it can ingest (web search, scraping, APIs, files, PDFs, DBs), how (scheduled? on-demand?), formats.

dimensions.label: Assessment & categorization
dimensions.question: scoring, classification, tagging, credibility/tier grading, dedup, taxonomy.

dimensions.label: Graphs & structures
dimensions.question: knowledge graph, entity/relationship extraction, linking, clustering, timelines, hierarchies; storage (DB, JSON, graph DB); visualization.

dimensions.label: Insight extraction
dimensions.question: trend detection, comparison, contradiction detection, gap analysis, “so-what” generation.

dimensions.label: Synthesis at multiple lengths
dimensions.question: long report, short report, key highlights/bullets, PowerPoint outline + slide text, other (email, memo, exec summary). Name the exact templates/prompts/renderers.

dimensions.label: Model flexibility
dimensions.question: which providers, is there a provider abstraction (single interface / factory / router), local (Ollama, MLX, llama.cpp, LM Studio) vs cloud (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, ...), embeddings model choice, config surface (env vars, config file), fallback/routing logic.

dimensions.label: Codex + Claude Code integration
dimensions.question: is it a Claude Code plugin (skills/commands/agents/hooks/MCP)? Codex (AGENTS.md, codex exec)? Both? Or standalone app/API? How does an agent invoke it?

subjects.name: market-intel
subjects.oneLiner: A Next.js 15 App Router UI shell for an RSS→AI news-summary product where every data path is hardcoded mock state — the backend (pages/api/*) that the tests and lib/database-api.ts call was deleted and never replaced.

health.summary: Dead — .git/refs missing, 40/40 tests fail at import, all data mocked

D1.evidence: No fetcher, no RSS parser, no scheduler, no rss-parser/cheerio dep. components/rss-controls.tsx:28-46 "Add source" is setTimeout(1000) + local useState; feed list is mockSources at :35-39. lib/database-api.ts:7,25,38,57,70,88 fetches /api/rss-sources, /api/articles, /api/summaries — none of those routes exist (app/ contains only layout.tsx, page.tsx, test/page.tsx), and DatabaseAPI has zero importers.
D1.cite: components/rss-controls.tsx:28-46; :35-39; lib/database-api.ts:7,25,38,57,70,88; /api/rss-sources; /api/articles; /api/summaries; app/; layout.tsx; page.tsx; test/page.tsx

D2.evidence: Category taxonomy is a 12-string literal array app/page.tsx:70-74; filtering is article.categories.some(...) app/page.tsx:97-101. No scoring, credibility tiering, dedup, or auto-tagging anywhere.

D3.evidence: No graph/vector/entity code. supabase-fix.sql:3-12 is the only persistence artifact — two RLS policies on an articles table; no schema, no migrations, no Supabase client instantiated despite @supabase/supabase-js in package.json:52.

D4.evidence: whyItMatters / keyDetails / bottomLine are literal strings in the mock fixtures (app/page.tsx:18-24, components/news-grid.tsx:14-21), rendered verbatim by components/news-card.tsx:76-107. No trend, comparison, contradiction, or gap logic.

D5.evidence: One length only, and it is string interpolation, not generation: components/summary-panel.tsx:24-41 setTimeout(2000) then template-literals the fixture fields into a "Why it matters / Key insights / Bottom line / Sources" markdown block. The real renderer's contract survives only as a test expectation — __tests__/api/summarize.test.ts:49-55 asserts a 3-part "Key Takeaway / Why it matters / Bulleted highlights" format from gpt-4o, temperature: 0, max_tokens: 500, system prompt containing "You are an expert summary assistant". No docx/pptx/email/exec-summary.

D6.evidence: openai@^5.3.0 is declared (package.json:60) and imported by nothing outside test mocks. Sole grep hits in shipping code are the words "OpenAI"/"GPT-5" inside mock headlines (components/news-grid.tsx:8-9). No provider abstraction, no local runtime, no embeddings, no router/fallback. Config surface = 3 keys in .env.local (NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY), all unread by source.

D7.evidence: .claude/settings.local.json is a 34-entry Bash permission allowlist only — no skills, commands, agents, hooks, MCP, plugin.json, or AGENTS.md. .navgator/architecture/ holds a NavGator scan (181 nodes / 361 edges, metrics.json:4-7, generated 2026-07-12). An agent can only drive it as a plain repo; nothing is callable.

strengths: The deleted summarizer's contract is fully recoverable from its tests — exact model, params, system-prompt opener, output shape, and the 405/400/empty-choices error branches (__tests__/api/summarize.test.ts:23-100).

components/news-card.tsx implements a genuinely reusable "structured brief" card — lead → expandable Why-it-matters / Key-details / Bottom-line / sources — that maps cleanly onto any synthesis payload.
__tests__/integration/api.integration.test.ts:7-9 uses the skipIfNoApiKey pattern to keep live-API tests opt-in, which is the right gating idiom for a shared suite.
scripts/preflight-next.sh + POST-MORTEM.md encode a real, hard-won Next-15/React-19 failure mode (blank-but-"Ready" dev server) that transfers to sibling Next repos.
gaps: The whole backend is missing, not stubbed. pages/ was deleted (POST-MORTEM.md §1 item 4 says a legacy pages/ folder was shadowing App Router — it was removed and its api/summarize handler went with it), stranding all 40 tests and all 6 DatabaseAPI methods. Nothing in the UI ever issues a network request.

Every "AI" behavior is a setTimeout faking latency: refresh app/page.tsx:82-86 (2 s), add-source components/rss-controls.tsx:31-36 (1 s), summarize components/summary-panel.tsx:23-42 (2 s), save :45-49 (1 s). Mock-data-as-real throughout.
Broken git (.git/refs/ absent) means ~2 weeks of working-tree changes have no recoverable history and git log/status/diff are unusable until the ref is rebuilt from .git/logs/HEAD.
.env.local holds a live-looking OPENAI_API_KEY plus Supabase URL/anon key in a repo whose .gitignore is the only thing protecting them; no code consumes any of the three.

reuse.what: the executable spec for a GPT-4o brief endpoint (model/temperature/max_tokens/system-prompt/response shape + error branches). Port this as the contract test for the unified repo's summarizer; it is worth more than the code it tested.
self-contained structured-brief card (collapsed lead, expandable why-it-matters / key-details / bottom-line, source-link chips). Drop-in renderer for any synthesis output with that field set.
the markdown assembly template ("Why it matters / Key insights / Bottom line / Sources"); reuse as the prompt output format spec, discarding the setTimeout fake at :23.
a complete, current shadcn/Radix v1.x-on-React-19 component set already reconciled with Tailwind v4; cheaper to copy than to re-scaffold.
Next.js dev-server preflight and recovery, applicable to any sibling Next 15 app.

subjects.role: Retire. Salvage the summarizer contract test and news-card; the RSS role moves to the new collector.

subjects.name: market-research
subjects.oneLiner: A local-first, privacy-tiered document-research app (Vite/React web UI + mra Node CLI + thin SwiftUI Mac shell) that ingests files/URLs, indexes them in LanceDB with hybrid BM25+dense+rerank retrieval, and emits a cited Pyramid-Principle summary via Ollama or cloud LLMs.

D1.evidence: src/lib/parsers/fileRouter.ts:104-162 routes PDF/XLSX/CSV/PPTX/DOCX to dedicated parsers; src/lib/parsers/urlScraper.ts:111 scrapes URLs via @tyroneross/scraper-app through api/local/scrape.ts; src/lib/parsers/hybridParser.ts:70-116 picks LlamaParse-cloud vs local per sensitivity; cli/index.ts:144 mra ingest <pathOrUrl>. On-demand only — no scheduler, no web-search, no DB/API connectors.

D2.evidence: Per-parse confidenceScore (src/lib/parsers/pdf.ts:104, wordParser.ts:115); sensitivity classification by keyword list (hybridParser.ts:315-317 confidential|proprietary|classified) gates cloud vs local; theme tagging (src/lib/utils/themeExtractor.ts:9); naive Jaccard-ish dedup (src/lib/aggregation/aggregationEngine.ts:53-72). No source credibility tiers, no taxonomy, no cross-source dedup.

D3.evidence: No knowledge graph, no entity/relation extraction, no timelines. Only flat theme clustering (src/lib/aggregation/hierarchicalMerge.ts:78 clusterByTheme, with per-source fallback at :95-112) plus storage in LanceDB (src/lib/services/lanceVectorStore.ts:75) and Dexie/IndexedDB (src/lib/db/schema.ts). Citations are chunk-id links, not a graph.

D4.evidence: Contradiction handling exists only as a prompt instruction (hierarchicalMerge.ts:169 "If the excerpts contradict each other, surface the contradiction…"; same in hierarchicalChunkingService.ts:349). No trend detection, gap analysis, or comparison module — getCostComparison hits are about $ cost, not content (aiService.ts:983).

D5.evidence: One shape only: PyramidSummary = conclusion → 3-5 arguments → cited evidence (src/lib/constants.ts:184-205 prompts; hierarchicalMerge.ts:335 aggregateHierarchically two-pass cluster-then-merge with chunk re-injection and alias-mapped citations). Renderers: DOCX + JSON in cli/index.ts:332-390 (docx lib), React/markdown in src/components/PyramidSummary/PyramidSummary.tsx:101. No PPTX, no short/long variants, no email/memo. UI "Export Summary" button is dead — onExportSummary is never passed from src/App.tsx (SummaryPanel.tsx:929 renders it permanently disabled).

D6.evidence: Provider registry src/lib/constants.ts:31-180 (ollama / openai / groq with ~9 Groq models, per-model pricing). Local: src/lib/services/ollamaService.ts:112 (chat + embed, env-overridable VITE_OLLAMA_CHAT_MODEL/_EMBED_MODEL, 404→qwen3:8b-q4_K_M fallback at :219). Router with health probe: aggregationEngine.ts:330 resolveProvider (ollama|openai|auto, localOnly forces local). Local embeddings + local cross-encoder rerank Xenova/bge-reranker-base (src/lib/services/reranker.ts:76). Config surface: .env.example, cli/config.ts (~/.market-research-app/config.json), Settings UI, ModelMigration for retired model IDs. No Anthropic/Gemini/LM Studio.
D6.cite: src/lib/constants.ts:31-180; src/lib/services/ollamaService.ts:112; qwen3:8b-q4_K_M; aggregationEngine.ts:330; Xenova/bge-reranker-base; src/lib/services/reranker.ts:76; .env.example; cli/config.ts; ~/.market-research-app/config.json

D7.evidence: No plugin.json, no .claude-plugin/, no AGENTS.md, no MCP server (searched repo-wide). .claude/agents/*.md holds 8 generic project subagents (backend-api-engineer, system-architect, …) and market-research-app/.claude/settings.json only wires @tyroneross/bookmark snapshot hooks. Agent access is via the mra CLI (cli/bin.ts, commands scrape/parse/ingest/search/summarize/health/config) or the local HTTP routes under api/local/.

strengths: Retrieval stack is genuinely mature and self-contained: hybrid BM25+dense+RRF with graceful dense-only fallback (lanceVectorStore.ts:171-231), local cross-encoder rerank on by default, optional multi-query rewrite kept behind a flag with the honest note that it didn't help.

Hierarchical merge is defensive in ways that read as hard-won: short alias chunk-ids so small local models can cite correctly, per-cluster char budget, per-source cluster fallback documented against an observed PPTX-truncation failure (hierarchicalMerge.ts:66-77).
True local-only path end-to-end — parse → embed → index → summarize → DOCX with zero cloud calls (cli/index.ts:256-390).
Privacy tiering is enforced in code, not just policy: sensitivity detection routes sensitive docs away from LlamaParse (hybridParser.ts:70-150).
gaps: Dead modules: src/lib/services/enhancedSummaryService.ts (407 lines), summaryService.ts, src/lib/processors/scalableDocumentProcessor.ts (487 lines) have zero importers outside themselves.
src/lib/services/localLLMService.ts:100-170 is a regex/keyword "LLM" — hardcoded business-term list and /trend/i patterns masquerading as extraction; superseded by the Ollama path.

The web UI's Export Summary button is a no-op (D5 above); DOCX export exists only in the CLI. The two aggregationEngine paths also diverge — the OpenAI branch still uses the old single-pass prompt with no re-injection.

Repo hygiene: ~25 root-level status/assessment .md reports, dev*.log, 1.2 MB of committed Lighthouse output, PNG screenshots, 6 ad-hoc test-*.js scripts, SimpleTest.tsx, plus a stale duplicate ../src/lib/ (3 files) outside the git root.
.env.local is present on disk in the app root — inspect before any repo sharing.

reuse.what: LanceDB store with hybrid BM25+dense+RRF search, FTS index creation, and dense-only fallback; pluggable embedder.
provider-agnostic (LlmClient = {chat(prompt, system)}) cluster→merge summarizer that returns a citation-bearing PyramidSummary; the most portable asset here.
local chat/embed client with model-missing fallback and health check, plus an in-process Xenova/bge-reranker-base cross-encoder.
multi-format extraction with confidence scoring and sensitivity-based cloud/local routing.
the mra command surface (scrape/parse/ingest/search/summarize/health) is the cleanest agent-callable entrypoint and the reference wiring for the whole pipeline.

subjects.role: Reference only (TS): port the reranker and hierarchical-merge ideas; park the app.

subjects.name: market-research-platform
subjects.oneLiner: Local-first FastAPI + React platform that ingests documents/URLs, embeds them into SQLite (sqlite-vec + FTS5), and map-reduces a cited StrategyBrief into PPTX/DOCX/email/notes/outline deliverables.

D1.evidence: Uploads + in-process parsers for PDF/DOCX/XLSX/PPTX/image-OCR/python (backend/app/parsers/__init__.py); URL ingest scrapes via Node sidecar /scrape (backend/app/api/documents.py:248-330, services/parser-sidecar/src/index.ts). All on-demand — no scheduler, no web-search API anywhere.

D2.evidence: T1–T4 source-tier scorer with ~55 seeded domains (backend/app/verification/source_scoring.py:15-80); deterministic claim verification + confidence roll-up (backend/app/verification/brief.py:31-60); 5-dimension brief-fidelity rubric (backend/app/reporting/quality.py:1-40). No dedup, no taxonomy/tagging.

D3.evidence: Graph code exists but the runtime graph is empty. graph_store is imported only by graph/ingestion.py and graph/research.py; both are reachable only through graph/pipeline.py, whose ingestion and research entry points have no callers. The live api/documents.py path never touches graph_store, Kuzu, spaCy, or entity extraction. add_relation also has zero callers, so no relations can be written.

D4.evidence: Theme/claim/financial/risk/action extraction with context re-injection (backend/app/reporting/strategy.py:1-20); SWOT/competitive/trend prompts exist in backend/app/graph/research.py:61-66 but that graph is dead (no caller — see D8) and the API says so (backend/app/api/research.py:29-32). No contradiction or gap detection.

D5.evidence: Five renderers off one StrategyBrief: pptx_generator.py:117 (via vendored engines/pptx-builder build_deck + QA gauntlet), docx_generator.py:260, email_generator.py:22, notes_generator.py:23, outline_generator.py:20; registry at backend/app/graph/reporting.py:34-42. Plus Minto-pyramid answer synthesis in /ask (backend/app/api/documents.py:665) and an earnings_call prompt template (backend/app/reporting/prompts/earnings_call.py).
D5.cite: pptx_generator.py:117; engines/pptx-builder; docx_generator.py:260; email_generator.py:22; notes_generator.py:23; outline_generator.py:20; backend/app/graph/reporting.py:34-42; /ask; backend/app/api/documents.py:665; backend/app/reporting/prompts/earnings_call.py

D6.evidence: Real abstraction: LLMProvider base + OllamaProvider / MLXProvider / ClaudeProvider + LLMFactory with local-first, cloud_allowed-gated Claude fallback (backend/app/llm/factory.py:18-67,420-469). Embedder abstraction with Ollama / MLX / sentence-transformers (backend/app/embeddings/__init__.py:53-232). Config via MRP_* env / .env (backend/app/config.py:26-62). MLX is genuinely wired but half-integrated — see gaps.

D7.evidence: No plugin.json, no .claude/skills|commands|agents|hooks (.claude/ holds only bookmarks + audit), no MCP server, no root AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md. Agent entry is HANDOFF-TO-CODEX.md prose + the HTTP API. Vendored engines carry their own skill specs (engines/pptx-builder/SKILL.md, engines/docx-builder/skills/…, engines/pyramid-principle/AGENTS.md) but nothing registers them with a host.
D7.cite: plugin.json; .claude/skills|commands|agents|hooks; .claude/; AGENTS.md; CLAUDE.md; HANDOFF-TO-CODEX.md; engines/pptx-builder/SKILL.md; engines/docx-builder/skills/…; engines/pyramid-principle/AGENTS.md

strengths: Provider abstraction is real, not cosmetic: one LLMProvider interface, streaming opt-in via supports_streaming, per-call model= override, and a processing_mode gate that makes "local" mean local (factory.py:442-458).
Vector store namespaces dense tables by (project_id, embedder_name) so changing embedding models can't corrupt prior data; FTS survives re-embedding (vector_store.py:1-16).
Deterministic, no-LLM verification + quality layers (source tiering, claim support, 5-dim rubric) that other repos could bolt on unchanged.
Ollama model self-healing: if the configured tag isn't installed, it auto-selects the strongest installed one instead of silently 404-ing every map call (factory.py:131-157).
gaps: MLX integration stops at the factory. grep -rl mlx hits only config, factory, embeddings, tests, docs/mlx.md — nothing in api/health.py, api/models.py, or the frontend. Worse, tier selection still asks Ollama for tags (strategy.py:198-220, _list_installed_ollama_tags), so with local_llm_provider="mlx" and Ollama also running, an Ollama tag is sent to the MLX server as model. Tests are mocked-httpx only — no live MLX run ⚠️.

get_embedder() under embedding_provider="mlx" logs _active.dim, which forces the probe HTTP call at selection time and raises if the MLX server is down — no graceful fallback, unlike the Ollama path (embeddings/__init__.py:216-221).

Dead pipeline: run_ingestion / run_research / build_research_graph have no callers outside graph/pipeline.py; api/documents.py re-implements parse→chunk→embed itself. graph/research.py docstring still cites LanceDB/A-RAG that no longer exist.
The graph pipeline is unreachable from the live app, so the runtime Kuzu store is empty; add_relation is also uncalled. api/research.py:25 still advertises "LanceDB cosine".

reuse.what: self-contained httpx-only Ollama/MLX/Claude provider + factory with local/cloud enforcement; drop-in for any repo needing local-first generation.
embedder interface + auto-probe selection (Ollama preference table, MLX, ST fallback) returning L2-normalized vectors.
sqlite-vec + FTS5 hybrid search with RRF fusion, embedder-namespaced tables, reembed_project(); zero heavy deps.
deterministic T1–T4 domain tiering and numeric/text claim-support checking; input is plain dicts + a pydantic brief.

reuse.path: backend/app/reporting/ renderers (pptx_generator.py, docx_generator.py, email_generator.py, notes_generator.py, outline_generator.py)
reuse.what: all share generate_X(brief, path) -> {"path", …}; pure Python, no LLM, callable off any object matching reporting/models.py:StrategyBrief.

subjects.role: Donor for vector store, embeddings, MLX provider, email/notes/outline renderers, OCR. Its React UI is the natural “platform” face later; not needed for the agent workflow.

subjects.name: Omniparse
subjects.oneLiner: A TypeScript file-parsing SDK + CLI (plus an optional local Next.js app) that converts Excel/PPTX/Python/PDF files and directories into LLM-ready Markdown, text, and JSON — pure extraction, no intelligence layer.

D1.evidence: Local files only: .xlsx/.xls/.csv/.tsv/.ods/.xlsb, .pptx, .py, .pdf, and recursive directories — packages/sdk/src/router.ts:88,116,175; concurrency-limited batch via p-limit. On-demand only; no scheduler, no web search, no scraping, no API/DB ingest — URLs are explicitly rejected (packages/sdk/tests/run-tests.ts:37). Second ingest path = HTTP upload packages/web/app/api/parse/route.ts:44. PDF extraction is hand-rolled BT/ET + FlateDecode regex, text-PDF only, no OCR (router.ts:507-538).

D2.evidence: Only extension-based type classification (router.ts:104-130) and heuristic token estimation. No scoring, credibility tiers, tagging, dedup, or taxonomy — grep for those terms returns nothing outside CSS class names. Web UI "types" are display color maps (packages/web/lib/mock-data.ts:20).

D3.evidence: Rich intra-document structure: merged cells, hyperlinks, named ranges, charts+series, comments, embedded images (packages/sdk/src/parsers/excel-parser-rich.ts:106,887); Python imports/functions/classes/variables (python-parser.ts:19-137); PPTX slides + speaker notes. Storage is a 2-table SQLite schema, Project→Document only (packages/web/lib/db.ts:31-71). No entity/relation extraction, no cross-document linking, no clustering, no timeline, no graph store, no visualization.

D4.evidence: Absent. Closest artifact is buildStructureSummary() (packages/sdk/src/parsers/excel-parser-fast.ts:644) — descriptive counts (hasRichContent, image/chart counts), not analysis. No trend, comparison, contradiction, or gap logic anywhere.

D5.evidence: Three renderers per parser: generateMarkdown() / generatePlainText() / JSON (python-parser.ts:819,915; CLI -f markdown|text|json at packages/sdk/bin/omniparse.ts:65). RAG-oriented buildChunks() emits typed content chunks (excel-parser-fast.ts:568). No report, exec-summary, memo, email, or PPTX-outline template exists — output length is a function of input size, not an author-chosen register.

D6.evidence: Zero LLM code. Full-repo grep for ollama|mlx|llama|openai|anthropic|claude|gemini|groq|bedrock|litellm hits only prose comments and one bookmark snapshot. No embeddings, no vector store, no provider abstraction, no model env vars. SDK runtime deps are p-limit + sax only (packages/sdk/package.json). "LLM-ready" means token-counted Markdown, nothing more.

D7.evidence: Not a plugin: no plugin.json, .claude-plugin/, AGENTS.md, MCP server, skills, commands, or agents (find returns empty). .claude/settings.json holds only @tyroneross/bookmark context-snapshot hooks — unrelated to parsing. An agent invokes it as a subprocess or import: npx omniparse <path> -f json, or import { parse } from '@tyroneross/omniparse'. Clean, but no first-class agent surface.

strengths: Real, tested, single-pass OOXML parsing with no Python/native deps — Excel rich content is reverse-engineered straight from ZIP/XML rels chains (excel-parser-rich.ts:635-801), which is genuinely hard-won and reusable.

Clean unified dispatch contract: every parser returns the same ParseResult shape with markdown/text/metadata/estimatedTokens/parseTime (router.ts:31-50) — trivially composable as an ingest stage for another repo.
51/51 tests pass against real binary fixtures (39 .xlsx/.pptx/.xls/.py files under packages/sdk/tests/fixtures/), not mocks.
Published, provenance-signed package with dual-registry release automation.
gaps: The CLI is a parallel implementation of the router. bin/omniparse.ts:141-155 re-declares SUPPORTED_EXTENSIONS and getFileType() and dynamically imports parsers directly instead of calling detectInputType/parse. Two detection tables to keep in sync; the CLI silently misses any router improvement.
.docx fixtures exist (tests/fixtures/large/ffc.docx, ffc.xls-adjacent) with no Word parser — dead fixtures implying unshipped capability.
Search is LIKE %q% over text/markdown with no FTS index (packages/web/lib/store.ts:147-155) — O(n) full-column scan, no ranking, no snippets beyond client-side slicing.
Committed build output (packages/sdk/dist/, 16 MB) and two .archive/dirty-cleanup-* folders; README license (MIT) contradicts package.json (Apache-2.0).

reuse.what: parse(), parseMultiple(), detectInputType(); the whole ingest front door, concurrency-limited, one uniform result shape.
pure Buffer → {images, charts, comments, mergedCells, hyperlinks, namedRanges}; no filesystem coupling, the most valuable standalone unit here.
runtime-free static analysis returning imports/functions/classes/variables; usable as a code-entity extractor feeding someone else's graph builder.
emits typed, size-bounded chunks explicitly designed for embedding/RAG; the natural seam to attach an embedder that this repo lacks.
single-pass ZIP read yielding slide text + speaker notes together, no python-pptx dependency.

subjects.role: Keep as-is, consumed by subprocess. Fix the CLI/router duplicate table; add DOCX.

subjects.name: local-smartz
subjects.oneLiner: A local-first multi-agent research application (Ollama + LangGraph/DeepAgents) that routes a query through planner→researcher→analyzer→fact-checker→writer specialists and saves markdown/HTML/DOCX reports — shipped as a CLI, an HTTP+SSE web UI, and a native macOS app.

D1.evidence: tools/web.py:172 scrape_url (httpx+bs4, HTML tables→markdown at :147), :237 web_search (ddgs); tools/documents.py:10 parse_pdf (pypdf→pdfplumber fallback :63), :103 read_spreadsheet (openpyxl), :186 read_text_file. All on-demand tool calls only — no scheduler/cron/watcher anywhere in src/, no DB or API connectors.

D2.evidence: No source scoring, credibility tiering, taxonomy, or content dedup. What exists grades agent output, not data: agents/prompts/fact_checker.md:37 verdict contract {"verdict":"ok"|"needs_more","missing_facts":[]}, agents/prompts/reflector.md:13 4-axis rubric. agent_scorecard.py:1 and query_doe.py:1 score the harness/router, not ingested material. Only dedup is per-turn tool-call suppression (serve.py:2309).

D3.evidence: No networkx/neo4j/entity/relation/cluster/ontology code — grep over src/**/*.py returns nothing. Structure is flat JSON: artifacts.py:82 .localsmartz/artifacts/index.json, threads.py:50 per-thread JSON + langgraph-checkpoint-sqlite for conversation state. Embedding models are cataloged but dead — models/catalog.py:204 qwen3-embedding entries and models/registry.py:11 "embed" Role literal have no consumer; no vector store, no retrieval.

D4.evidence: Gap analysis is real and enforced: fact-checker names missing facts and the graph re-runs the researcher up to pipeline.py:62 MAX_FACT_CHECK_ITERATIONS = 2. agents/prompts/analyzer.md:10 mandates cross-source comparison and outlier/inconsistency flagging with every number computed via python_exec (tools/compute.py). Critique loops in patterns/critic_loop.py, patterns/reflection.py. No trend detection over time, no corpus-level contradiction detection.
D4.cite: pipeline.py:62 MAX_FACT_CHECK_ITERATIONS = 2; agents/prompts/analyzer.md:10; tools/compute.py; patterns/critic_loop.py; patterns/reflection.py

D5.evidence: tools/reports.py:12 create_report with three real renderers — _create_markdown_report:179, _create_docx_report:228 (python-docx), _create_html_report:300 — plus create_spreadsheet:71. Template is agents/prompts/writer.md:19 (Title / Exec Summary / Key Findings / Detailed Analysis / Recommendations / Sources). PowerPoint is prompt-only: agent.py:141-143 instructs a # Slide N: <title> markdown outline and explicitly forbids .pptx binary output — no python-pptx dependency. No email/memo template.

recommendation.bottomLine: You already own every layer of the workflow except one — but each layer is implemented two to five times, in two languages, and no repo is mature or central in more than two of the seven dimensions. The universal hole is graph / relationship structure (best score anywhere: 2/3, research-plugin's wikilink backlinks; MRP's Kuzu graph pipeline never reaches the live app). Insight extraction is prompt-encoded everywhere with no deterministic engine.
recommendation.spine: research-plugin (the only live, dual-host Codex + Claude Code plugin, 187 entries, written to yesterday) as the knowledge substrate and agent surface, fed by Omniparse (already vendored there) and stratagem's SEC/scrape tools, with three donor modules bolted on: local-smartz/runners/ for a headless local/cloud provider router, market-research-platform/backend/app/storage/vector_store.py for sqlite-vec embeddings, and stratagem/tools/reports.py + presentation.py (plus MRP's email/notes/outline generators) as the one renderer set. Build the graph layer once, on top of research-plugin's SQLite. Retire market-intel; park market-research's web UI.
